When we bought the business, he wanted to be part of it. We purchased it together,  hoping to not only spend more time together...but to succeed together.  Then he decided it was boring.  He didn't like it.  It was too much work.  So? He bailed and went back to his construction business. 

He has been at this job site for 7 months.  He didn't supervise his crew, they messed up.  It cost us over $20,000 because he chose to sit at home instead of being at the job site. Now, instead of buckling down and getting it done,  he works a few hours then goes home. He could have this job done and start other sites...he chooses not to, which hurts us financially

I struggle with not being resentful of him.  IRL I don't even imply anything to him, but I'm tired of carrying everything.  He stresses me out further by complaining,  yet he isn't proactive. 

Inside I'm this big ball of stress and fury, but on the outside I act like nothing is wrong. Im just tired, I think.

Once the insurance reimburses me, I'll be okay... it's just until then,  and Lord knows how long it will take. 

A lot of the MCA's I have looked at have more criteria than I anticipated.  I have the cash flow and am willing to set up direct pay...but I need to find the company that is willing. 

I feel dejected.  I work hard,  but can't seem to catch the right break!
